detail: ^(CompoundFileStructureError: Corrupt CFBF container: the sector chain starting at sector \d+ reaches sector \d+, which the file does not hold\.|ConversionFailedError: LibreOffice could not read the \.xls file: it is damaged(, encrypted)? or not a valid XLS document\.)$
reason: The file is cut off: its header lists 29 FAT sectors (3,712 sectors) and the file holds 3,391, so the Workbook stream chain reaches sector 3,659 and the mini FAT starts at sector 3,656, neither in the file. xlrd refuses it and the suite cannot load it with the Excel 97 filter; with no filter the suite's type detection imports the container bytes as text, which was the 'ok' of the baseline (a 1,447-page PDF of binary), and the generation filter of entry 207 ends that. Padding the missing sectors makes the suite print 49 pages, but no established reader repairs a cut file (entry 71).

detail: ^CompoundFileStructureError: Corrupt CFBF container: the sector chain starting at sector \d+ reaches sector \d+, which the file does not hold\.$
reason: The file is a copy cut off at 4 MiB (4,194,304 bytes, 8,191 sectors) of a larger one: its header lists 115 FAT sectors and the first directory sector is sector 14,632, and the DIFAT starts at sector 14,516, none of them in the file. xlrd refuses it and the suite cannot open it as a storage, so its type detection imported the container bytes as text (2,909 pages of binary), which was the 'ok' of the baseline; the pre-check of entry 381 ends that.

detail: ^CompoundFileStructureError: Corrupt CFBF container: the sector chain starting at sector \d+ reaches sector \d+, which the file does not hold\.$
reason: The file is a copy cut off at 598,016 bytes (1,167 sectors) of a larger one: its header lists 260 FAT sectors, the first directory sector is sector 33,225 and the DIFAT starts at sector 32,963, none of them in the file. xlrd refuses it ('MSAT extension: accessing sector 32963 but only 1167 in file') and the suite cannot open it as a storage, so its type detection imported the container bytes as text (364 pages of binary), which was the 'ok' of the baseline; the pre-check of entry 381 ends that.
